description.narrative: Adama is a railway transit town with a population of 127,842 (7-18 population is 63,352) of which over 2000 are children living off on/the the streets. The railway is a big attraction for business opportunities and many people have fallen into the trap of chasing dreams which have resulted in poor livelihoods. Children have either been born or migrated to this place in search of opportunities and many are living tough lives eking a living as porters, casual workers, sex workers simply living on the streets. The rights of these children are trampled upon every day and they have limited safety nets. This application will undertake a research into the context of the street children in the country and Adama in particular, the extent of the problem, the nature of the problem, the available opportunities for addressing the problems. It will map out existing services and identify the key stakeholders. The result will be a greater understanding of the situation of street children in Adama, the opportunities there are to address any identified issues, and design of appropriate interventions. Implementation of follow-on programmes should ensure the upholding of the rights of street children, and ensuring a brighter future for them.
